Honestly, yes — from my point of view it's the same page, so I'd want Trove to recognize it and take me to the one I already have, keeping my title, note, and labels rather than starting a fresh copy. That trailing slash or the little "?ref=..." bit the site tacks on doesn't mean anything to me; it's still the same article.

I'll be honest that the case I care about most is when I paste the exact same address again — that absolutely must not make a duplicate. Being smart about those minor variations on top of that would be a real bonus and very much in the spirit of what I asked for. As long as it doesn't ever wrongly merge two genuinely different pages, I'd welcome it catching those near-identical ones too.
